source: AeroNav charts for Tokyo Intl (aeronav.space), read from the charts' text. Fix names only; positions come from 24SPY via scripts/build-navdata.js. Fixes missing from 24SPY are listed in the plan response as unplaced.
note: Runway keys can be lists ("20,31"); runway 02 is written 2 in the navdata and is matched either way. 'vectors' means the chart ends the procedure with radar vectors rather than a fix.

sids.name: ASTRO1
sids.title: ASTRO 1 RNAV DEPARTURE

initial.2: Climb to above 2000 on heading 020, then expect radar vectors to ASTRO.
initial.31: Climb to above 1000 on heading 310, then climbing left heading 180 direct ASTRO.

sids.notes: Maintain 2000 until the filed altitude is assigned. The BLANK transition is for Grindavik arrivals only.

initial.2: Climb on heading 020 to intercept course 060 to LETSE below 200 kt, then track 110 to HONDA.
initial.20: Climb to 500 on heading 200, then climbing left turn heading 065 direct HONDA.

sids.name: LETSE1
sids.title: LETSE 1 RNAV DEPARTURE

initial.2: Climb on heading 020 to intercept course 060 to LETSE below 200 kt.

sids.notes: Caution for runway 13 departures if that runway is in use.

initial.13: Climb on heading 130 to intercept course 175 to ONDER.
initial.20: Climb on heading 200 to intercept course 145 to ONDER.

sids.name: TOKYO1
sids.title: TOKYO 1 DEPARTURE
sids.notes: Expect radar vectors to the filed route.

stars.name: KNIFE2
stars.title: KNIFE 2 RNAV ARRIVAL
stars.notes: The chart also shows PROBE and DINER transitions; only the ONDER route is encoded.

approaches.name: ILS OR LOC RWY 13
approaches.missed: Climb to 700 on heading 127, then climbing right turn to 2000 and outbound on HME R210 to PIPER and hold.

approaches.name: ILS OR LOC RWY 20
approaches.missed: Climb to 1500 and outbound on HME R165 to URAGA, then hold.

approaches.name: ILS OR LOC RWY 31
approaches.missed: Climb to 700 on heading 307, then climbing left turn to 2000 and outbound on HME R215 to PIPER and hold.

approaches.name: RNAV (RNP) RWY 13
approaches.missed: Climb to 700, then climbing right turn to 2000 direct ONDER and hold.

approaches.name: RNAV (RNP) RWY 20
approaches.missed: Climb to 700, then climbing left turn to 2000 direct KAIHO and hold.
approaches.notes: RNP 0.20 - authorization required. Which of MOCHA / LATTE is the IF and which the FAP is inferred from the RWY 13 chart.

approaches.name: GLS RWY 31
approaches.missed: Climb runway heading to 2000 until 2 DME HME, then the 2 DME arc counter-clockwise to HME R215 outbound to PIPER and hold.
